title_full_candidates_20260929_v2/title_.title: 轻松候选 · 晴海假日 · 完整时长候选

request.prompt: Light sophisticated anime daily-life title-screen music for a naval game. Warm nylon-string acoustic guitar with a gentle bossa nova sway, melodic acoustic piano, playful but soft clarinet, rounded acoustic bass, very light brushed percussion and discreet string touches. Friendly sunlit melody, relaxed companions on a free afternoon, mature warmth rather than childish comedy. Clear memorable melodic opening, tasteful restrained variation and gentle return. Moderate easy tempo, no rushing, busy virtuoso solos or sharp percussion. Match the natural warm orchestral title pool in tonal balance and restrained energy. Natural closing phrase. Entirely instrumental, no vocals, choir, singing or speech. Music only, no waves, ambience, weapons or sound effects. Clear warm piano, mellow woodwinds and natural strings share a coherent anime naval game identity. Stable timing and sustained tones, clean attacks, smooth legato without flutter, stuttering or abrupt edits. Keep accompanying high violins sparse and quiet, with clear melodic foreground. Balanced natural stereo, moderate dynamics, no sudden loud hits. Develop complete musical phrases throughout the full 210-second piece; reprise the melody before a short natural closing cadence in the final seconds, no premature fade or extended silent tail. Develop a complete extended form with distinct melodic sections, a contrasting middle and a returning main theme. Maintain musical continuity and gentle variation across the full duration without excessive repetition. Reserve the closing cadence for the end.
